name: Chest pain with breathing difficulty
description: Combination of chest pain and difficulty breathing may indicate a life-threatening condition.
trigger_patterns: shortness of breath with chest pain
recommended_action: Seek immediate emergency medical attention. Do not wait for a clinic appointment.

name: Stroke-like symptoms
description: Sudden face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty, or numbness may indicate stroke.
recommended_action: Call emergency services immediately. Time-critical care is required.

name: Loss of consciousness
description: Unresponsive patient or sudden collapse requires emergency evaluation.
recommended_action: Call emergency services immediately and ensure the person is safe.

name: Severe uncontrolled bleeding
description: Heavy or non-stop bleeding requires urgent emergency care.
recommended_action: Apply pressure if safe and seek emergency care immediately.

name: Severe allergic reaction
description: Allergic reaction with breathing difficulty or facial swelling is an emergency.
recommended_action: Seek emergency care immediately. Do not delay.

name: Suicidal emergency
description: Statements about self-harm or suicide require immediate crisis support.
recommended_action: Contact emergency services or a crisis helpline immediately. You are not alone.
